title: Contracting homotopy of each augmented Godement stalk complex
statement: For every scheme $X$, module sheaf $F$, cosimplicial module object $A$ and augmentation $a:F[0]\to K(A)$ satisfying ModuleCupGodementModel, and every point $x$ of $X$, the map of stalk complexes induced by $a$ is a homotopy equivalence. Its inverse and homotopies are induced by evaluation of the corresponding stalk-product coordinate. No global quasi-isomorphism or flasqueness is asserted.

source.place: Godement resolution; Lemma 20.30.1 (0FKS); monad multiplication and tensor compatibility: Banerjee, arXiv:1004.1491, section 1.1.4, pp. 15--16.

proof.text: Define stalk evaluation as the stalk map of the product projection followed by skyscraperStalkEval. The product universal property and skyscraperHomEquiv.left_inv prove evaluation after the germ unit is the identity. The same adjunction identity proves naturality for moduleCup_godementMap. The stalk functor is additive by the underlying abelian-group stalk functor.

Separate the zero coface from the finite alternating sum using Fin.sum_univ_succ. The zero insertion followed by evaluation is the identity. Every successor insertion is the Godement map of the preceding insertion, so naturality moves evaluation past it. The successor signs negate the remaining sum; hence the differential followed by evaluation equals identity minus evaluation followed by the previous differential. Transport coface sums along the model term equalities and extendXIso.

Construct the retraction in degree zero by the term isomorphism, stalk evaluation, and the inverse single-object isomorphism; put its other components equal to zero. Its chain-map equations follow from zero objects in negative degrees and from the target being concentrated in degree zero. Construct degree-lowering maps from coordinate evaluation in each positive degree, and put all other components equal to zero. The alternating-sum identity gives the Homotopy.comm equation in positive degrees. In degree zero, the specified augmentation identity identifies the missing summand with the retraction followed by augmentation. Negative degrees are zero.

Prove the augmentation followed by the retraction is the identity degreewise: in degree zero apply the specified augmentation equation and evaluation after the unit, and elsewhere use the zero source. Homotopy.ofEq gives one homotopy. Package the degree-lowering maps and the established differential identity as the other homotopy, reverse its orientation with Homotopy.symm, and construct HomotopyEquiv with forward map exactly the given stalk augmentation.

lean.statement:
theorem moduleCup_godement_stalk_contraction (X : Scheme.{u}) (F : X.Modules)
    (A : CosimplicialObject X.Modules)
    (a : (CochainComplex.singleFunctor X.Modules 0).obj F ⟶
      (((alternatingCofaceMapComplex X.Modules).obj A).extend
        ComplexShape.embeddingUpNat))
    (h : ModuleCupGodementModel X F A a) (x : X) :
    HomologicalComplex.homotopyEquivalences
      (ModuleCat.{u} (X.presheaf.stalk x)) (.up ℤ)
      (((RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor X.toRingedSpace x).mapHomologicalComplex
        (.up ℤ)).map a)
